messages:
maya: FYI my PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823) is failing the docs preview. Linkcheck shows a couple 404s and Vale flags PassiveVoice in the migration examples. Can someone pick this up for review?

david: I can take a look but I have a deploy in ~30m. Is it blocking merge right now? :hourglass_flowing_sand: Which Vale rule is it exactly?

maya: Vale is reporting `PassiveVoice` on examples/migration.md (a few explanatory sentences). Linkcheck: `https://old.example.com/sdk` -> 404 and one relative link returns 301 -> broken anchor. I patched the broken link locally but the vale failures remain.

sam: docs-preview logs show the failing step: `vale linter` — output snippet: 
```
examples/migration.md:23 PassiveVoice: "was updated" -> consider active voice
examples/migration.md:78 PassiveVoice: "is recommended" -> consider rewording
```

lucy: We shouldn't turn off `PassiveVoice` globally, it's useful. For this doc we can either reword the sentences or add an inline disable around the example block. Prefer rewording if it's trivial.

maya: Rewording one is easy, the other is in a long table and will be messy. I'll add an inline Vale disable only around that table: `<!-- vale disable PassiveVoice -->` and close after the block. Also I'll update the SDK link to `https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk` which redirects correctly. Pushing in a minute.

david: Sounds good. After you push, can someone re-run the docs-preview? I don't have perms to re-run CI for this repo.

lucy: I can re-run. Two options: Actions UI -> docs-preview -> Re-run jobs, or use the GH CLI: 
```
gh run list --workflow docs-preview.yml
gh run rerun <run-id>
```

devops-bot: Re-run triggered by lucy. docs-preview now queued.

devops-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck PASSED, vale still shows 1 PassiveVoice on examples/migration.md:78 after patch.

maya: Ah missed that one. Quick edit pushed to fix wording. Pushing now and marking PR ready for review. @david can you review after your deploy?

david: Just finished the deploy, looking now. Quick nits only. Approving in a sec. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks! Merged at 2170012380 — updated docs site deploy will follow automatically.
